contract: docs/POPUP_UI.md: a 360px native popup, compact languages/site/activation/settings hierarchy, visible recovery paths, shared rounded text surfaces and lightweight glass appearance.

accessibility.evidence: Actual native popup keyboard input saves languages, toggles site access, restores focus after saving and activates the content script. Settings and access recovery remain reachable. Axe has zero A/AA violations for the native first-use view and three extension-document widths, including forced colors. Native labels/focus and enlarged text are checked. This is limited automated evidence; manual screen-reader and Chrome permission-dialog coverage remain open.

responsive.evidence: Chrome's actual first-use action view measures 360x448 with matching scroll dimensions, replacing the reproduced 146px column. The same extension document fits 375x812, 768x900 and 1440x900 viewports. Long hostnames stay bounded; a text-size fixture at 125% fits. A longer access request can scroll vertically inside Chrome's height cap without horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: popup-fixture-loading.png holds preference/model reads: disabled language controls and concise Checking model feedback. It is a labeled rendering fixture, released by reopening the popup.

empty.evidence: popup-native-empty.png reads actual missing-model metadata: a one-line 912MB model setup row and Set up action. The model is not downloaded automatically.

error.evidence: popup-native-save-error.png shows a deliberate storage-write fault as visible retry/reopen feedback. popup-fixture-error.png separately exercises unavailable model status and Set up.

partial.evidence: popup-fixture-partial.png explicitly replays incomplete model metadata: Download incomplete and Set up retain the resume path. No actual partial model download is claimed.

success.evidence: popup-native-enabled.png follows actual trusted activation and content-script injection. Reopening recognizes active controls; disable/allow still requires explicit reactivation. popup-fixture-ready.png separately illustrates ready-model metadata.

permission.evidence: The actual site switch gates activation and cancellation. A seeded pending-host record renders the real native access UI and keyboard-reachable grant action in popup-native-permission.png. Unsupported Chrome pages disable activation with website guidance. Chrome's native grant dialog remains manual and is not marked tested.
